text: Your sleep stays on this phone and is never sent anywhere.
page: Phone app, Settings > Health apps > Sleep and workouts (switch on)
proof: Code lines: readLastNight (sleepLink.ts:247-262) only returns the night; its one caller ShortDayLine.tsx:40-43 keeps it in screen state and draws it. No test asserts that sleep is not stored or sent.

text: It never shows your name or body weight.
page: Phone app, share sheet, line under the Share button (gym shown)
proof: Body weight: liftedOnPicture (workoutInput.ts:64-80) leaves body weight out; test/tracker/f146Share.test.ts:138 covers the before/after picture. Member name: no test found that checks the name is absent from every picture; f146Share.test.ts:175 checks only the sentence.

text: The picture never shows your name, your gym or your body weight.
page: Phone app, share sheet, line under the Share button (gym hidden or no gym)
proof: Gym: withGym returns the picture unchanged when no gym is passed (gymBrand.ts:109-110). Body weight: workoutInput.ts:64-80. Member name: no test found that checks the name is absent; test/tracker/f146Share.test.ts:176 checks only the sentence.

text: Workouts on demo data are never sent.
page: Phone app, Settings > Health apps, line under Send past workouts
proof: Code lines: send() returns 'demo' before any write when isDemoData is true (healthConnect.ts:337-340); the only native write, healthWrite at :349, sits inside send(). The health tests mock isDemoData as false, so no test runs the demo branch.

text: Nothing to send: workouts on demo data never leave your phone.
page: Phone app, Settings > Health apps, notice after tapping Send past workouts
proof: Health Connect route proven by code (healthConnect.ts:340); test/tracker/r72HealthSend.test.ts:30 checks the notice only. Other ways off the phone (backup, gym sync) were not checked in this step.

text: Only workouts logged in MettleUp are sent.
page: Phone app, Settings > Health apps, line under Send past workouts when older workouts are left out
proof: pastWhere sends only workouts started after MettleUp first ran (healthConnect.ts:403-405; test/tracker/healthOldForgeAi.test.ts:79). But the file header says imported Hevy/Strong workouts are sent too (healthConnect.ts:20), and when the first-run time is unknown every workout counts (healthConnect.ts:389).

text: We build your routines from it.
page: Phone app, import screen, Strong row subtitle
proof: findRoutines builds a routine only from a workout name used at least the minimum number of times (routineRebuild.ts:256, :271; test/tracker/routineRebuild.test.ts:30 says 3+). A file with no repeated names gives no routines.

text: After your workouts come in, we build your routines from the workouts you repeat most.

proof: The code takes every workout name used 3+ times and orders them by rotation and recency, not by how often they repeat (routineRebuild.ts:240-272; test/tracker/routineRebuild.test.ts:30, :100).
